main: Replaced the loose meme array with one typed registry backed by a canonical readonly tag list.
Rewrote all 75 meme titles as short trader-native punchlines and standardized every tag as a single searchable token.
Kept meme tags visible on mobile so search context remains available at every screen size.
Removed interface transition delays so every interaction responds immediately.
Combined the brand and search into one compact sticky header for continuous access while browsing.
Simplified the search field to a plain Search prompt without a shortcut badge.
Simplified the home page to the brand header, search field, meme gallery, and minimal footer.
Corrected titles and tags for image files whose filenames did not match their actual meme content.
Started Trader Memes from the g-moe/.template TypeScript workspace.
Added a responsive one-page gallery with live name and tag search, quick filters, and an empty state.
Added copy-image behavior with a download fallback for unsupported browsers.
Cataloged all 75 existing memes in one readonly TypeScript configuration.
Renamed workspace validation to repository validation across tooling and documentation.
Added filename-based Node, jsdom, integration, and Playwright test suites.
Added Chromium Playwright installation and end-to-end execution to CI.
